# Solv3d

Solv3d is a Singapore-based team focused on practical digital transformation for SMEs.

## Summary

Solv3d helps businesses improve the way work already happens before adding unnecessary complexity. The team works on website revamps, workflow automation, internal tools, reporting workflows, and careful AI implementation.

## Core Services

- Website revamps: clearer structure, messaging flow, UX, and implementation for client-facing businesses.
- Workflow automation: reduce repetitive manual work around existing processes and tools.
- AI implementation: identify realistic AI use cases and only proceed when the source material, process, and review path are ready.
- Internal tools and reporting: improve operational visibility, handoffs, and routine work.

## Audience

Solv3d is built for SME teams that need practical digital improvement without hiring a large consultancy or waiting for a perfect technology stack.
